candidate_relations.reason: The clinical presentation of reddish-brown hyperkeratotic papules with compact hyperkeratosis, epidermal atrophy, and band-like lymphocyte infiltrate on biopsy is characteristic of Hyperkeratosis lenticularis perstans (HLP). Necrobiosis Lipoidica typically presents with atrophic, yellowish-brown plaques with telangiectasias, and histologically shows necrobiosis of collagen. While the patient has diabetes, the clinical and histological findings do not support Necrobiosis Lipoidica.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Necrobiosis Lipoidica vs. Hyperkeratosis lenticularis perstans
